hints.content: The inequality $x>1$  is read as $x$ is greater than $1$.
So, we need to graph all values that are greater than $1$.

options.alt: A number line from negative 5 to 5 with evenly spaced tick marks in increments of 1. An open point is plotted at 1. A line running to the right starts at 1 and continues.

question.content:
**Choose the graph of the inequality  $x>1$.**
